social_formats.description: Group theatrical parade with role separation (sick persons, medical team, mosquitoes) interacting with festival crowds.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Broad gestures imitating medical treatment, mosquito buzzing/swatting, and throwing flour into crowds.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Troupe-based parade and open crowd spaces during public festivals.
movement_profile.partnering: Role-play interaction between patients, doctors, nurses, and mosquitoes.
movement_profile.posture: Exaggerated sickly, slumped, or dramatic medical postures depending on character role.

signature_moves.description: Throwing flour into the audience to visually mimic the spread of malaria.
signature_moves.name: Flour throwing

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid throwing flour into open eyes or mouths of unwilling participants.
